nasa_apod.title: Spokes on Saturn's B Ring
nasa_apod.explanation: Don’t get spooked by Saturn’s ghostly spokes! Today we feature a nearly two-hour timelapse of Saturn and its rings looping forwards and backwards. If you look closely, a ghoulish shadow appears and disappears as  Saturn’s B ring  rotates. Decades of observation with  Voyager 2,  Cassini, and Hubble ...
